text:
Priya (PM): Quick sanity check before UX review: proposing a responsive pattern for the Usage & Billing card. Desktop: chart full-width with compact inline legend above the x-axis. Mobile: legend collapses into an accordion above the chart. Need feedback on clarity, keyboard access, and whether invoices should surface the same microcopy.
Marco (Design): I prefer inline for desktop — immediate visibility. For mobile the accordion works. Two visual notes: 1) show small color chip + short label (e.g., "Prompt (input)") to reduce wrapping; 2) add a "show all" link to expand long project lists. Mock: https://figma.example/ux-compact-legend :art: 
Jen (Eng): Implementation caveats: expanding lists will need virtualization for orgs with 200+ projects. If we do "show all" it should be paginated API-side. Also prefer legend as semantic list (<ul>) not purely graphic for screen readers.
Alok (Data): Usage split: org-level views read 75% of the time for top-20 customers; smaller customers prefer project-level. Default scope should be org if account has >1 active project else default to project. We can toggle in backend.
Priya (PM): Good rule. Let's keep that as default logic. What about token naming? API docs use "input" but billing uses "prompt". We should converge.
Marco (Design): Use parenthetical style: "Prompt (input)" and "Completion (generated)" across UI and invoices. Short tooltip copy: "Prompt (input): tokens sent in your request". Keep tooltip <100 chars.
Maya (Support): Please ensure invoice CSV headers match UI labels exactly. Customers open tickets when CSV uses "input_tokens" but UI says "prompt". Also request: attachment alt text "Monthly usage chart for ACCOUNT" in invoice emails.
Jen (Eng): Accessibility notes: legend chips need keyboard focus and aria-pressed for toggling series visibility. If legend collapses, ensure it is reachable via Tab and not hover-only. Chart canvas needs descriptive aria-label summarizing main trends (e.g., "Usage rose 12% month over month").
Marco (Design): Color palette proposal to avoid colorblind issues: blue #2563EB, orange #F59E0B, green #10B981. Will check WCAG contrast for small labels.
Alok (Data): Small ask: can we add a secondary metric line for "cost per 1k tokens" option? Some customers want to correlate tokens with dollars inline.
Priya (PM): Interesting—add as optional overlay toggle in legend. Marco, include that in the mock. Jen, estimate for a low-fidelity prototype and keyboard/a11y baseline?
Jen (Eng): Can prototype chart + accordion + legend focus behaviors in ~4 days. Cost overlay toggle is extra but doable in the same spike. Full CSV + invoice alt text will be a separate PR.
analytics-bot: pulse-report: no recent regressions for billing API endpoints.
Priya (PM): Great. Action items: Marco update Figma with compact chips, color update, and overlay toggle. Alok to confirm default-scope rule. Jen to prototype and include aria labels. Maya to draft CSV header guidance for docs. Sync Friday 11am for sign-off. Thanks everyone.
